title: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/messages.c:235: DAO-ACK write uses wrong bit for D-flag
description: Line 235 sets D-flag in bit 6 (0x40) but parse at line 203 reads bit 7 (d_byte >> 7). Per RFC 6550, D is bit 7 (0x80). Roundtrip fails: D=1 messages are parsed as D=0, and the 16-byte DODAGID is ignored during parse while present in buffer, causing subsequent option data to be misinterpreted.
close_reason: Already fixed: D-flag write corrected from 0x40 (bit 6) to 0x80 (bit 7), and flags mask from 0x3F to 0x7F, aligning with RFC 6550 and the parse path at line 203
